threads.body: The new registry links send consumers of `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`, including embeddings consumers, to this recommendation, but inference counters do not include embeddings usage. `docs/gen-ai/gen-ai-token-metrics.md:46-48` explicitly uses the sum of `gen_ai.client.embeddings.operation.input_tokens` for embeddings totals. Please scope this recommendation to generation and link the embeddings alternative so readers do not omit embeddings from token accounting.

threads.body: This inference-only query can omit all reported usage for a remote agent invocation. For example, `reference/scenarios/aws-bedrock-agent/scenario.py:119-157` records usage on the client `invoke_agent` span without emitting the remote inference spans. Since the agent usage attributes now link here, please state that this example measures visible inference usage, not the trace's complete token usage, and explain that remote-agent usage must be queried separately rather than added indiscriminately to inference usage.
